QuestInfo.name: The Secrets of the Puppeteer
QuestInfo.0: Hurry over to the where the Black Wings were spotted.
QuestInfo.1: Defeat Francis and Dargoth of the Black Wings.
QuestInfo.2:
After beating the tar out of #p2159394#, you found out the Black Wings were planning to use #p2154009# to catch you, but this fact is being kept a #bsecret from Orchid#k, the leader of the Black Wings.
Report these findings to #bProfessor Dreamboat#k.

0.0: This cave has a high probability of housing the Black Wings. I'd better take a look.

yes.0: This place is strange. The owner seems to have an odd preoccupation with dolls...

no.0: Maybe I'd better calibrate my scanners first...

1.0: How could #p2159395# abandon me like that?! *Sniff-sniff*\r\n#L0##bPlease stop crying. I need information.#l\n#k
1.1: You think you're so tough? How would YOU like it if you kept getting your butt kicked?! Everybody I ever meet is just another dumb thug!\r\n#L0##bI do not want to fight you any further. Tell me more about #p2154009#.#l\n#k
1.2: How can I trust you?\r\n#L0##bI'll keep my promise.#l\n#k
1.3: You're lying, I don't trust your-your... spooky eyes!\r\n#L0##bWould it help if I ran a tear simulation?#l\n#k
1.4: You're a creep. DON'T CRY, I'll believe you... jeez...\r\n#L0##bCrying together is a good way to convince people to do things. Thank you for the observation. Now tell me what #p2154009# ordered you to do.#l\n#k
1.5: H-He just told me to find #ba suspicious guy carrying a stretching sword#k... He told me to keep it a secret, even from #bOrchid#k. Wait! That's you! \r\n#L0##bOrchid, the head of the Black Wings?#l\n#k
1.6: Yeah, that's weird, isn't it? #p2154009# must have some kinda crazy scheme if he wants to keep Orchid out of it... But I will not let him prevail! I am #p2159394#, genius puppet shaman and Orchid fanboy!\r\n#L0##bIf that's the case, you shouldn't have to follow #p2154009#'s order to capture me, right?#l\n#k
1.7: I, uh, suppose you have a point.\r\n#L0##bIf #p2154009# questions you, tell him I escaped after you defeated me in battle.#l\n#k
1.8: R-really? Okay, that doesn't sound too bad. Ahem, you better be thankful!\r\n#L0##bOf course.#l\n#k
1.9: Hmph. I don't know WHY #p2154009# has a smart person like you in his sights, but I appreciate your understanding how amazing I am. Take this...

yes.0: It's not because I like you. It's just that I enjoy when people respect me.
